_meta.title: DFCC starter pipeline
_meta.note: Starter values entered by Datum for DFCC to edit. Realistic in shape and internally consistent, not DFCC's confirmed figures. Recorded (not sample): once loaded these are the organisation's own records and fully editable. Replace each figure with the exact confirmed value before any submission.
_meta.provenanceSource: Starter values entered by Datum Solutions for DFCC — edit to the exact confirmed figures.

projects.name: Commercial & Industrial Rooftop Solar Facility
projects.selectionReason: A concessional facility on-lent to commercial and industrial rooftop solar on estates DFCC already banks, extending tenor beyond what commercial debt reaches for these borrowers.
projects.essNote: Rooftop installations on existing buildings; limited, site-specific, readily mitigated impacts.

financing.gcfInstrumentDetail: Concessional loan on-lent through DFCC to extend tenor. No grant element.

viabilityWithoutGcf.reason: Commercial tenor for these borrowers falls short of the rooftop-solar payback period; GCF's tranche buys the missing years of tenor rather than a margin subsidy.

annual_tCO2e.method: installed capacity x specific yield x grid emission factor

baseline.description: Grid electricity displaced at the Sri Lankan national average emission factor
baseline.counterfactual: Without the facility the same demand is met from the national grid

indirect.definition: People working on the served sites

projects.name: Smallholder Climate-Resilient Agriculture and Micro-Irrigation
projects.selectionReason: Resilience of smallholder farming to drought and erratic monsoon through micro-irrigation and drought-tolerant inputs, in the districts the National Adaptation Plan prioritises.
projects.essNote: Community-level works with a gender and stakeholder plan; no large infrastructure.

financing.gcfInstrumentDetail: Resilience outcomes are not paid for by any market; results-based finance is the structure that reaches them.

viabilityWithoutGcf.reason: The adaptation benefit has no buyer, so no commercial structure prices it. The instrument that reaches it depends on the grant modality DFCC does not currently hold — a mandate question to verify with DFCC and the NDA.

annual_tCO2e.note: Adaptation project; mitigation is a co-benefit and not the basis for ranking.

baseline.description: Not a mitigation project; no mitigation baseline is claimed
baseline.counterfactual: Resilience of livelihoods, measured in beneficiaries reached rather than tonnes
baseline.note: Type is a required field; for a pure adaptation project it carries no weight because no mitigation tonnage is claimed.

mitigation.coBenefitNote: Any emissions benefit is incidental to the resilience objective and sits on its own line.

indirect.definition: Wider rural community dependent on the same catchment

projects.name: Electric Bus Fleet and Depot Charging
projects.selectionReason: A risk-sharing facility for a private operator's electric bus fleet and depot charging, displacing diesel on high-frequency Colombo routes where ridership and duty cycle are known.
projects.essNote: Depot works on existing land and fleet replacement; site-specific, mitigable impacts.

financing.gcfInstrumentDetail: A first-loss risk-sharing layer that lets DFCC lend against an unproven local duty cycle for electric buses.

viabilityWithoutGcf.reason: Lenders price an untested local electric-bus duty cycle at a rate the fare box cannot carry; GCF's first-loss layer, not a margin subsidy, is what makes the facility bankable.

annual_tCO2e.method: diesel bus-km displaced x diesel emission factor, net of grid charging emissions

baseline.description: Diesel buses operating the same routes and schedule
baseline.counterfactual: Without the facility the routes continue on diesel buses

direct.definition: Daily riders on the electrified routes

indirect.definition: Wider population along the corridors from cleaner air and quieter streets
